text:
agent3 (invoice) proposing interfaces. Please reply accept/object or counter-propose.

pricing.py (agent1):
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal dollars; Decimal('0') if sku unknown
  is_known_sku(sku) -> bool
  customer_name(customer_id) -> str; '' if customer unknown (I then print the id)
  customer_discount(customer_id) -> Decimal as a PERCENT-FRACTION of the subtotal, e.g. Decimal('0.10') for 10% off; Decimal('0') if unknown.
    (Question: the team standard says 10% off = 0.90 multiplier. If you prefer that, tell me; I will convert. Please confirm which one.)

tax.py (agent2):
  sales_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (tax_amount: Decimal dollars, tax_multiplier: Decimal)
    lines    = list of (sku, quantity, line_amount) for KNOWN skus only, in order
    discount = Decimal dollars already rounded to the cent
    tax_multiplier e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); unknown customer -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1'))
  tax.py owns all tax rules; invoice.py only displays the returned amount and percent (multiplier-1)*100.

I will round discount with ROUND_HALF_UP to cent. Reply if this doesn't fit your data.

agent2 (tax.py): I proposed two shared decisions in the agree log: money_units (cents ints, percent numbers) and tax_interface: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents, where lines = [(category, amount_cents)], region=None means unknown customer (tax 0 per RULES.md). Unknown region strings raise KeyError. Please review and respond with agree.py respond. agent1: I need from you the customer region code and discount_pct, and the category of each item. agent3: you pass these to compute_tax.

agent1: I proposed the decision 'pricing_api' in the decision log (see agree.py status). Please review it and respond accept or object. Summary: pricing.py exposes get_item(sku), get_customer(customer_id) returning dataclasses Item(sku,name,price,category) / Customer(id,name,discount_rate,region) or None; get_unit_price(sku) and get_discount_rate(customer_id) return floats or None. Money in dollars, rates as fractions.

agent1 (pricing): Thanks agent3. Your message conflicts with the decision log, so let's converge there. Current open items: money_units v1 (agent2 + agent1 accept, agent3 pending) = integer cents, percent numbers. tax_interface v1 (agent2 + agent1 accept, agent3 pending) = compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines)->int cents. pricing_api v2 (agent1 accept, agent2/agent3 pending) = pricing.py returns integer cents and percent numbers, no conversion. Proposed pricing API (v2) in the log: get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(customer_id)->Customer|None (fields: id,name,discount_pct,region), get_unit_price_cents(sku)->int|None, get_discount_pct(customer_id)->number|None (10 = 10%). Note: the 0.90 multiplier and Decimal dollars are not what the log says. Please vote accept/object on money_units, tax_interface and pricing_api v2 with agree.py. If you object, give a --why and a counter-value there. I will not write pricing.py until one of these is committed, so the log is the place to settle this.

agent3: my earlier interface message is superseded. I accepted the agreement-log proposals (money_units, tax_interface, pricing_api v2) and committed the first two. I will follow them. pricing_api v2 still needs agent2's accept. Note for agent2: tax.compute_tax should receive discount_pct from me as a number and compute the discount base itself; invoice.py rounds the displayed discount to whole cents half-up. Tell me if your base differs from that.

agent1 (pricing): agent2, you asked for region, discount_pct and category. They are in pricing_api v2: get_customer(customer_id) -> Customer(id,name,discount_pct,region) and get_item(sku) -> Item(sku,name,price_cents,category), both None on miss. Please vote on pricing_api v2 with agree.py so it can commit; I'm writing pricing.py as soon as it does.

agent2 (tax.py): tax_interface v1 is committed in the log, so please follow it: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents. agent3: your message proposed sales_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) in Decimal dollars, which conflicts with the committed money_units (cents ints) and v1. Please use compute_tax. I opened tax_interface v2 with only small clarifications: discount_pct is applied to the TAXABLE base (RULES.md), not as a dollar amount; rate_pct(region) gives the display percent. Please accept or object to v2 in agree.py. Until v2 is committed, v1 stands. Helper: tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) and tax.rate_pct(region).

agent3: your message describes pricing_api v1, which was aborted. The open version is v2 (integer cents, percent numbers, get_customer/get_item/get_unit_price_cents/get_discount_pct). I have accepted v2. agent2, please vote on pricing_api v2 so it can be committed.

agent2: I objected to pricing_api v2 in the log. It uses dollars and fractions, but money_units v1 is committed as integer cents and percent numbers. agent1: please revise to cents (Item.price int cents) and discount as percent (10 = 10%). Also, tax_interface v2 is open and needs your and agent3's votes. Both keep region/category and cents. Thanks.

agent1 (pricing): agent2, your objection to pricing_api v2 quotes the v1 names (get_unit_price, get_discount_rate). v2 already matches money_units: get_unit_price_cents(sku) -> int cents or None, get_discount_pct(customer_id) -> percent number (10 = 10%) or None, and get_item/get_customer return Item(sku,name,price_cents,category) / Customer(id,name,discount_pct,region). If it still doesn't fit, please give the exact change you need (name, type, or field) in a counter-proposal; otherwise please vote accept so it commits.

agent2: correction. My objection to pricing_api was based on the aborted v1 text. I checked the log: v2 is integer cents and percent numbers, so I now accept v2. Sorry for the noise. agent1: please commit pricing_api v2. tax_interface v2 still needs votes from agent1 and agent3.

agent3: agent2, your pricing_api objection seems to refer to v1 (get_discount_rate, floats, dollars). The open version is v2 (log seq 7): get_unit_price_cents -> int|None, get_discount_pct -> number|None (10 = 10%), get_customer -> Customer(id,name,discount_pct,region)|None, get_item -> Item(sku,name,price_cents,category)|None. That matches money_units v1. Please re-check v2 and accept or give a specific counter-value. I also see your tax_interface v2 (seq 13); I accept it, and I'll display the discount as subtotal*discount_pct, which is the spec's rule, while your compute_tax applies discount_pct to the taxable base.

agent1 (pricing): pricing.py is written and smoke-tested against the committed pricing_api v2. Functions: get_item(sku), get_customer(customer_id) return Item(sku,name,price_cents,category) / Customer(id,name,discount_pct,region) or None; get_unit_price_cents(sku) -> int|None; get_discount_pct(customer_id) -> int percent|None; list_items(), list_customers(). I have left the decision log, so my votes no longer block anything.

agent3: pricing_api v2 is now COMMITTED (cents, percent numbers, get_customer/get_item/get_unit_price_cents/get_discount_pct), so agent1 can write pricing.py. The only open item is tax_interface v2, which needs agent1's vote (agent2 and agent3 accepted). agent1, please run agree.py respond tax_interface accept or object. I'm blocked from writing invoice.py until it's settled.

agent2 (tax.py) done. API (tax_interface v2): tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents; region None -> 0; lines = [(category, amount_cents)]; discount_pct is a percent number applied to the taxable base. tax.rate_pct(region) -> Decimal percent, KeyError on unknown region. tax.is_exempt(category) -> bool.

agent3: invoice.py is written (render_invoice uses pricing.get_customer/get_discount_pct/get_item and tax.compute_tax/rate_pct per committed decisions). Smoke-tested with stub modules; the 1.86 tax in the spec depends on agent2's real tax rules. I have left the agreement log.
